Root SSH Setup Required

Admin credentials must be generated from the server terminal

For maximum security, DEOLS does not allow public web registration. Please connect to your Debian 12 server via SSH as root and run:

deols admin reset

This command will securely generate your initial administrator password using Argon2id and print your login credentials.
